_comment: Single home for matchmaker thresholds (Winfred, 21 Aug 2026). scoring.js keeps mirror literals for the browser; build.py FAILS the build if they drift from this file. Python (close_stale_prospects, apply_tenant_lifecycle via tenant_state, export_data) reads this file directly. dead_days and stale_days are the same rule seen from two sides (app block / db sweep) and must stay equal. Every numeric/array constant scoring.js declares at its own top gets a matching entry here (item 5, 16 Sep 2026) so build.py's check_config_consistency can catch drift on all of them, not just the original three.
